evaluated_by: synthesis pass by the single synthesis owner (Claude agent), 2026-10-10; not an independent review
pass_condition: Intervention, controls, falsifier, metrics, leakage, and statistics specified
protocol: K-Dense experimental-design and statistical-power (vendored): design before data (2x2 factorial blocked by task and seed, one serving session, seeded interleaving), power by exact noncentral-t computation and Monte Carlo (compute/power-gate.py, seeds 42/43/44); K-Dense statistical-analysis and ARS statistical reporting standards for paired, clustered inference and TOST
evidence: Intervention (catalog language x document direction), controls (en baseline, en-RTL, exact CPU A/A checks G2b and G4), manipulation checks (G5-G10), falsifiers P1-P6, kill criteria K0-K6, primary estimand D with a three-way decision, a registered power gate on pilot-measured inputs, moderators frozen before GPU, leakage controls (disjoint pilot and main seeds, fresh English baseline).
why_fail: every base-rate distribution in the simulation is assumed; no Relay pixel measurement exists for a local model
the between-task heterogeneity tau2 of the locale effect cannot be measured before treatment; logit-scale effect models give realized tau2 of about 0.006-0.02 against the gate's 0.0025 floor
the simulated probability that the gate passes is at most a few percent in every assumed scenario, and conditional power given a pass is low for effects concentrated in a quarter or half of the tasks
no Phase 0 code exists, so the gate thresholds (4 px, 98%, 0.05 CER margin) are unexercised
remediation: Build Phase 0 and run its gate as a cpu-doctor orx node; run the Stage 1a pilot to replace the transport; consider design decision 9's alternative (fixed tau2 0.006), which closes Phase 1 on Relay
